items.title: Ripple backs an RLUSD credit fund amid XRP's best week in months
items.snippet: Clearpool and Cicada Partners are building an institutional lending product using RLUSD, though the XRP Ledger features underpinning it are still awaiting activation.

items.title: MANTRA token sinks 18% to record low amid blockchain halt
items.snippet: The token recovered to about $0.0044 after setting a new low, while exchanges paused deposits and withdrawals from the halted MANTRA Chain.

items.title: Bitcoin, ether and solana climb as another $1 billion shorts get wiped out
items.snippet: The two-day short liquidation total has reached about $3.8 billion, after Thursday's figure set a record going back to 2021.
items.note: Негативний тон для BTC, ETH, SOL за ключовими словами -- варто звернути увагу.
